name: Jill Orel I
source:
“The sight of you in agony… will no doubt bring me the greatest of pleasures.”

King of the Kingdom of Grandol. Unlike his predecessor—whose greed and indulgence nearly ruined the nation—Jill Orel has ruled with fairness and earned the people’s admiration.
Yet to restore his country’s wealth, he has resorted to invading neighboring lands, earning the grim title of “The Plunder King.”
He is also notorious for his general disdain for others—most of all, the Holy Maiden.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/got/character/]the official website[/url].]
